description:
PR2: reusable classification, generic post-ingestion processing and automatic labeling. Planning only, authorized by user after joint product review.
Source: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_fa28a6b2fe70819199a0a178f96c7fb6
Parent feature: zaq-kw0. Branch: feature/labeling-pr2; worktree /Users/jad/Desktop/Jad/workspace/zaq/forks/jat10/zaq-feature-labeling-pr2. PR1 gate zaq-kw0.19 remains required; do not mark it approved or merged.

Agreed scope:
- general.classify is reusable text/categories -> probabilities, with no Ingestion dependency or label threshold. Shared validated agent/workflow/confidential Agent Event implementation.
- Shared user-editable threshold in RAG Decision section, default 80%, no per-label threshold. Capture at reservation; new setting applies only to future reservations, not existing/in-flight results.
- No Decision model => automatic labeling unavailable. Before enabled ingestion perform bounded model check. Interactive error asks proceed without classification or cancel before start. Background error proceeds without classification and reports problem. Persist run skip; later configuration recovery cannot reverse it. Mid-run classification failure never blocks ingestion and leaves affected new chunks unlabeled for failed decisions. Do not silently retry provider classification errors through infrastructure recovery.
- Manual decisions/values override delayed automation. Full reingestion replaces chunks and discards their assignments; manual document assignments survive. No reset-to-automatic or classification suggestion workflow.
- Definition-change reclassification is user-confirmed and chunk-scoped: only current chunks carrying the changed label, not prior negatives/unassigned chunks. Evaluate each confirmed chunk against all eligible automatic chunk labels; preserve manual overrides. New labels trigger no existing-resource work and apply to newly ingested files. Broader fresh classification requires explicit reingestion.
- Not now saves definition without inference. Retained stale labels stay visible and contribute to authorized filters/usage counts until replacement. No token/cost estimate UI.
- Reuse PR1 values, deletion, optimistic versions, authorized query contracts; additive migrations, generation/request guards and no Agent SQL.
- No automatic text-value generation, summarization, new model selector, label mutation tool exposure or full-text/vector filtering.

Execution and gates:
Six existing PR2 issues are moved under this epic without changing their IDs. New focused issues split settings, schema, preflight, scheduling, reclassification, projections, UI and validation work. A conservative serial dependency chain avoids premature starts and preserves old PR3 dependencies; implementation can refine independent edges only with explicit evidence.
Contract audit is the first blocking task: finalize unresolved technical choices/reuse evidence before coding. No tasks start automatically.
Policies: AGENTS.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md. Read relevant service guides/@moduledoc before edits. Zaq.Config.get/4 runtime seams, no global environment mutation. BO calls route via NodeRouter with trusted actor.
Existing consolidated feature UX gate zaq-kw0.15 -> E2E zaq-kw0.16 stays in PR3, with new PR2 scenarios added; no duplicate E2E issue. PR2 has immediate unit/integration/LiveView tests and its own review -> coverage -> final gate. Overall feature remains open until approved consolidated E2E. Epic creation does not authorize application implementation or code commit/push/merge.
